properties.description:
User feedback after accepting the overnight experiment. This is input for a future night mode that can progress the software autonomously and start with one click.

Overall conclusion, verbatim:

The good :

- you broke nothing existing, we had nothing to revert.
- change in granular and revertible commits and the whole thing are on branches not master

The bad :

- value overall is really low. I have no high value item done among 31 things achieved.
- i told you to focus on refining and removing but we end up with a balance of +2144 lines -338lines.
- a non negligable amount of worthless performance optimization.
- changes are really localized and basicaly we have no change at fundational level blocs apart from a few edit to relational ui.
- part of the changes require a before after to review and we don't have that to even understand if there was value at all in the change
- a non neglible part of change are not understandable by me.
- starting the whole thing was annoying because i had to write the whole initial prompt before going to bed when it should be a one click thing.
properties.title: Feedback on the overnight experiment and a future one-click night mode
